purpose: Same-origin Next route for placing orders and listing the authenticated customer's order summaries.
businessRules: POST forwards checkout placement to SHRESTA-BE with the HTTP-only customer session, draftOrderId, and Idempotency-Key.
Final placement expects the browser to have obtained a 15-minute checkout order ID through /api/customer-orders/draft first.
GET forwards profile order-history reads to SHRESTA-BE using the same HTTP-only session cookie.
The browser never receives or stores the raw backend customer session token.
All ShrestaApiError messages are passed through toShrestaUserMessage() — infrastructure codes become a generic string; 5xx responses return as 503.
401 responses additionally delete the session cookie so stale sessions are cleared client-side.
